text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't I do pretty well in that practice 
run earlier? Against Ramonu-senpai, no 
less!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, how so...? She completely 
overpowered me with her technique."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Relying on sheer technique on impulse— how 
unsightly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It's lacking, isn't it? —My physical body, 
that is.

After training, I accompanied Mejiro 
Ramonu to a cafe after she said she needed 
to nourish her body. A massive spread of 
food is laid out before her.
choice_data_list: Are you really going to eat all that?
Are you really going to eat that much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If it's lacking, just increase it. 
—Simple, right?
choice_data_list: 本当にこの量を食べるのか？
本当にこの量を食べるの？
choice_data_list_en: Are you really going to eat that much?
Are you really going to eat that much?

text_block_list.text:
Increase food intake to prioritize bulking 
up, and raise training load on top of that 
to achieve the ideal physique. —That seems 
to be her plan.
choice_data_list:
Still, isn't this way too much no matter 
how you look at it...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there is no such thing as a safe 
love.
choice_data_list: だけど、いくら何でも多すぎな気が……
choice_data_list_en: Still, I can't help feeling that's way too much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Saying that implies you must have an 
alternative plan in mind, yes?
choice_data_list: プランを練り直そう。食事は適量で
フィジカルを優先して、たくさん食べよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's rethink the plan. Just moderate portions for meals.
Let's prioritize physical fitness and eat plenty!

text_block_list.text:
I had some materials I'd hastily put 
together back when she was worried about 
her physical shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Balancing both physical prowess and 
skill... ...A more balanced—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well. Tell me the details.
choice_data_list:
It's a bit of a long story to explain, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: If so, that works out perfectly.
choice_data_list: 説明にちょっと時間がかかるけど
choice_data_list_en: It'll take a little time to explain, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Could you please portion out this dish? 
—For two people, please.

Listening to the new training plan, Mejiro 
Ramonu ate a measured meal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Mercilessly building, carving, and 
polishing one's physique—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
After all, this body is a vessel for 
pouring in the love I dedicate to racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I intend to make it even more 
beautiful, without leaving behind a single 
flaw.

Mejiro Ramonu finished every single dish 
from the massive spread she had prepared.
